# Honest Review of Cluely AI in 2026: The AI App That’s Faking Your Meetings
## What Is Cluely AI?
### Cluely’s Controversy
Public reaction was divided.

## Does Cluely Actually Work? Real User Reviews on Accuracy, Latency & Reliability
#### Cluely AI: How Responsive Is It?
**Latency** is the most documented problem. That’s fast enough to keep pace with a natural conversation. Some real-world testers say it’s a completely different story. [Delays of 5 to 10 seconds](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/cluely-ai-problems-review) between a question being asked and a suggestion appearing on screen are supposedly common, rendering it effectively useless for its intended purpose.

Having said that, latency is reportedly worse during the highest-pressure moments. The last thing you want to do is go into an interview without knowing what you’re talking about and being left hanging.

#### How Accurate is Cluely’s Transcription?
**Accuracy** is the second issue, and potentially the more dangerous one. Cluely has been reported to hallucinate or generate “ [completely nonsensical](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69c4a7adbfc00f2b8d586a3d)” text every now and then so you can’t even trust it for the basics. In a job interview, it means you might confidently relay utter nonsense to someone who will follow up on it specifically.

![One TrustPilot reviewer claims Cluely was only useful 20% of the time.](https://b2729162.smushcdn.com/2729162/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Poor-transcription-quality-.png?lossy=1&strip=1&webp=1)

#### So, Does Cluely Actually Help?
Instead of listening and responding naturally, your focus is split. That delay? Unless you’re practiced in the art of reading off an autocue, you’re likely to end up sounding like a total robot.

One user told us the prompts were wildly off, clunky, irrelevant, and often completely out of sync with the conversation. You’re not more prepared, just more distracted, trying to make sense of a sentence that doesn’t fit.

AI might give you a fancy sentence or a factoid, but without depth or follow-up, it falls flat.

AI responses—even if it is as fast as they say—still have a lag. You say it late. That messes with conversational rhythm and makes you look unprepared.

**You Seem Less Credible, Not More**

The tool that’s supposed to make you sound confident often has the opposite effect. Not to mention if you’re halfway through a call, interview, talk, whatever, and the tech breaks… well, it’s game over!

## FAQs About Cluely AI in 2026
### Is Cluely worth it for students?
**No**.
